# CleanBricks

> CleanBricks is a modern cleaning and property-care company launching in Lagos, Nigeria. It provides professional cleaning for homes, offices, short-lets, Airbnb spaces and businesses. Tagline: "Cleaner spaces. Better living."

## Services
- [Residential cleaning](/services/residential-cleaning): regular, deep, move-in, move-out, post-renovation, one-off and recurring cleaning for homes.
- [Short-let and Airbnb cleaning](/services/short-let-airbnb-cleaning): guest turnover cleaning, apartment resets, linen and room preparation, restocking support, pre-arrival cleaning.
- [Commercial cleaning](/services/commercial-cleaning): offices, retail spaces, studios, small business premises and common areas.

## Pricing
- [Pricing](/pricing): Light, Standard and Deep Cleaning prices in naira by property size (self-contained to 5 bedroom). Light Cleaning starts at ₦12,000. Offices and short-lets are quoted on request.

## Information
- [How it works](/how-it-works): tell us what you need, pick a time, we clean, enjoy the difference.
- [FAQs](/faqs): booking, pricing, coverage and service questions.
- [About](/about): why CleanBricks exists, mission, values and ambition.
- [Journal](/journal): practical cleaning and property-care guides.
